name: Product events
tagline: The analytics your app sends, kept per user and checked against a tracking plan.

capabilities.title: Four SDKs, unchanged
capabilities.text: PostHog capture, batch, e, decide and flags; Segment track, identify, page, screen, group, alias and batch; Mixpanel track, import, engage; GA4.

capabilities.title: Bodies as SDKs send them
capabilities.text: JSON, gzip or form-encoded bodies are all read, so the app's real SDK is used as is.

capabilities.title: Events per user
capabilities.text: Every event with its user and properties; event_people lists the users events arrived for, with counts.

capabilities.title: Tracking plans
capabilities.text: A plan lists the events a flow must send and the properties each needs, as {event, props, min}.

capabilities.title: Fail CI on gaps
capabilities.text: check_events answers ok: false with the missing events and properties, so a test run can fail on it.

capabilities.title: Personal data flagged
capabilities.text: E-mail addresses, CPFs and card numbers found in properties are flagged on the event, before they reach a real tool.

capabilities.title: Wait for an event
capabilities.text: wait_for_event returns the event once the app sends it, optionally with a property value.

capabilities.title: A collector that fails
capabilities.text: The next answers are 400, 413, 429 with Retry-After, slow, or half the events silently lost.

excerpts.title: A plan, checked against what arrived

callouts.title: Per source
callouts.text: PostHog, Segment, Mixpanel and GA4, each with the calls it accepts and its count.

callouts.title: SDK hosts
callouts.text: Point each SDK at its path on :8025; nothing else in the app changes.

callouts.title: Missing property
callouts.text: workspace_created arrived without plan, which the plan requires.

callouts.title: Missing event
callouts.text: trial_started never arrived: check_events answers ok: false.

callouts.title: Plans
callouts.text: One plan per flow, such as signup and invite.

callouts.title: 4 of 7 arrived
callouts.text: How much of the plan the app really sent in the window.

callouts.title: One event a line
callouts.text: Properties after a colon; the same plan works from set_event_plan.

callouts.title: Save the plan
callouts.text: Saved in events/plans.yaml, so tests and CI read the same plan.

advantages.title: Tracking is tested
advantages.text: Analytics breaks silently in production. A plan in CI fails the build when an event or property goes missing.

advantages.title: No real project polluted
advantages.text: Test runs do not pollute a real PostHog, Segment, Mixpanel or GA4 project, and cost nothing.

advantages.title: Personal data caught early
advantages.text: E-mails, CPFs and card numbers in properties are flagged before the app sends them to a real tool.

advantages.title: One place, four SDKs
advantages.text: Apps that use several analytics tools are checked in one list and one plan.

agent.prompt: Run the signup flow and tell me which tracking events are missing.
tools: Events, newest first, with user, properties and personal data
Wait until the app sends an event
Compare what arrived with a plan
